findings.source_passage: sketching the profile of a pyramid. Even Scoresby, the justly renowned Right whaleman
findings.source_locator: paragraph on French aptitude vs English/American draughtsmen
findings.why_it_matters: The pyramid simile ('about tantamount to sketching the profile of a pyramid') is a rhetorically distinctive, voice-establishing comparison that characterises Ishmael's satirical register; the draft drops it entirely.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the pyramid simile: 'which, so far as picturesqueness of effect is concerned, is about tantamount to sketching the profile of a pyramid.'

findings.source_passage: Sea fowls are pecking at the small crabs, shell-fish, and other sea candies and maccaroni, which the Right Whale sometimes carries on his pestilent back.
findings.source_locator: description of second Garnery engraving (Right Whale)
findings.why_it_matters: The phrase 'sea candies and maccaroni' is a textually distinctive, whimsical register-marker; its absence flattens the Garnery description and removes a characteristic touch of Ishmael's comic naturalism.
findings.suggested_fix: Reinsert the sea-fowl / sea candies detail within the Right Whale engraving description.

findings.source_passage: the black stormy distance the ship is bearing down upon the scene
findings.source_locator: description of first Garnery engraving (Sperm Whale)
findings.why_it_matters: The closing compositional detail of the ship bearing down in the black stormy distance completes the tableau and contributes to the interpretive weight Melville places on the engraving as a whole; its omission truncates the set-piece.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the background ship detail: 'while in the black stormy distance the ship is bearing down upon the scene.'

findings.source_passage: I am strongly tempted here to enter upon those still more monstrous stories … But I pass that matter by.
findings.why_it_matters: Ishmael's conspicuous feint—announcing a digression and ostentatiously declining it—is a voice-establishing rhetorical device; the draft skips straight to the survey, losing the mock-reluctance tone.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore a brief version of the opening feint, e.g. 'I am tempted to enter upon the more monstrous stories—Pliny, Purchas, Hackluyt, Cuvier—but I pass that by.'

summary: Three medium-severity losses—the pyramid simile, the 'sea candies and maccaroni' detail, and the closing ship-in-the-distance from the first Garnery tableau—together flatten Ishmael's satirical and whimsical register sufficiently to trigger regeneration.
